query='portable air conditioner'
page_limit=20
page_index=0
seller_best={}  # seller_id -> best product dict
sellers=set()
pages_fetched=0
while True:
    products=apis.amazon.search_products(query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    pages_fetched += 1
    print('page_index', page_index, 'count', len(products))
    if not products:
        break
    for p in products:
        sid=p['seller_id']
        sellers.add(sid)
        # choose best by product rating, then num_product_reviews, then lowest price
        cand = seller_best.get(sid)
        if cand is None:
            seller_best[sid]=p
        else:
            if p.get('rating',0) > cand.get('rating',0):
                seller_best[sid]=p
            elif p.get('rating',0) == cand.get('rating',0):
                if p.get('num_product_reviews',0) > cand.get('num_product_reviews',0):
                    seller_best[sid]=p
                elif p.get('num_product_reviews',0) == cand.get('num_product_reviews',0):
                    if p.get('price',0) < cand.get('price',0):
                        seller_best[sid]=p
    page_index += 1

print('pages_fetched', pages_fetched)
print('unique_sellers', len(sellers))
print('best_products_per_seller', len(seller_best))
# preview top 5 sellers by product rating among all sellers (not seller rating)
preview=sorted(seller_best.values(), key=lambda x:(x.get('rating',0), x.get('num_product_reviews',0), -x.get('price',0)), reverse=True)[:5]
print('preview_top_by_product_rating')
for p in preview:
    print(p['product_id'], p['seller_id'], p['name'], 'rating', p.get('rating'), 'reviews', p.get('num_product_reviews'), 'price', p.get('price'))

    products=apis.amazon.search_products(query=query, product_type=product_type, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    pages += 1
    print('page',page_index,'count',len(products))

        sid=p['seller_id']
        seller_ids.add(sid)
        cand=seller_best.get(sid)

            # pick best product by rating, reviews, price high? actually lower price better; also rating higher
            key=lambda x:(x.get('rating',0), x.get('num_product_reviews',0), -x.get('price',0))

    page_index+=1

    print('best_product_for_seller',p['seller_id'],p['product_id'],p['name'],'rating',p.get('rating'),'reviews',p.get('num_product_reviews'),'price',p.get('price'))
